yasuo.why: P reworks crit (doubled chance, overflow converts to AD, reduced crit multiplier) but its Flow shield is pure defense. Q is a plain crit-capable cast; its Gathering Storm empowerment only changes the CC (knockup), not the damage, so it needs no extra primitive. E ramps its own damage per stack, but its real cast cadence is capped by a same-target internal cooldown separate from its listed cooldown. R can only be cast on an airborne target - here that means landing Q's empowered knockup first and casting R inside that narrow window, a sequencing requirement beyond a flag check.
